facts.statement: A skeleton of Gobiraptor was discovered in 2008 by the Korea-Mongolia International Dinosaur Expedition at the Altan Uul III site in the Gobi Desert.
facts.quote: In 2008, the Korea-Mongolia International Dinosaur Expedition discovered an oviraptorosaurian skeleton at the Altan Uul III site in Ömnögovi Province, in the Gobi Desert.

facts.statement: The species Gobiraptor minutus was named and described in 2019 by a team including Sungjin Lee, Yuong-Nam Lee, Anusuya Chinsamy, Lü Junchang, Rinchen Barsbold, and Khishigjav Tsogtbaatar.
facts.quote: In 2019, the type species Gobiraptor minutus was named and described by Sungjin Lee, Yuong-Nam Lee, Anusuya Chinsamy, Lü Junchang, Rinchen Barsbold and Khishigjav Tsogtbaatar.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen dates to the early Maastrichtian, approximately seventy million years ago.
facts.quote: The holotype, MPC-D 102/111, was found in a layer of the Nemegt Formation, probably dating from the early Maastrichtian, about seventy million years old.

facts.statement: The holotype is a partial skeleton including the skull, lower jaws, pelvis, thighbones, and left foot.
facts.quote: It consists of a partial skeleton with skull. It contains the lower side of the skull, a left postorbital, the lower jaws, the last sacral vertebra connected to the two front tail vertebrae, a series of seven front or middle tail vertebrae, chevrons, the right shoulder joint with a piece of the humerus, the pelvis, both thighbones and the left foot.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen represents a juvenile individual.
facts.quote: It represents a juvenile individual.

facts.statement: Each dentary features a rudimentary triturating shelf on the top inner side pierced by four small oval occlusal foramina.
facts.quote: Each dentary has at the top inner side a rudimentary triturating shelf pierced by four small oval occlusal foramina.

facts.statement: Gobiraptor lived in a mesic habitat that was half-dry.
facts.quote: Gobiraptor lived in a mesic habitat, one that was half-dry.

facts.statement: Researchers considered it unlikely that Gobiraptor was a carnivore because its foot was not arctometatarsal and it was not a specialized running form.
facts.quote: As its foot was not arctometatarsal and the animal thus was not a specialised running form, the describing authors considered it unlikely that Gobiraptor was a carnivore.

facts.statement: Gobiraptor lived at the end of the Cretaceous period, approximately 70 million years ago, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 70 millones de años, en el Maastrichtiense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: Gobiraptor had an elongated premaxilla with a straight snout and a hollow lower section.
facts.quote: En el cráneo está el premaxilar alargado con un hocico recto, la parte inferior es hueca.

facts.statement: The lower view of the paired premaxillae formed a U-shape.
facts.quote: Juntos, los premaxilares tienen una forma de U desde abajo.

facts.statement: The upper jaw featured a frontal maxillary fenestra and maxillae perforated by holes of varying shapes, positions, numbers, and sizes.
facts.quote: En la parte superior de la mandíbula se puede ver una fenestra maxilar en la parte frontal y ambos maxilares están más perforados por diferentes formas de diferentes posiciones, formas, números y tamaños.

facts.statement: The left pterygoid bone preserves two visible lesions interpreted as tooth marks.
facts.quote: En boca se conserva casi por completo pero no muestra detalles. En la pterigoideo izquierdo hay dos lesiones visibles que se han interpretado como huellas dentales.

facts.statement: The front of the lower jaw dentary was bent at an angle of 32 degrees.
facts.quote: El dentario frontal está doblado en la parte frontal en un ángulo de 32°.

facts.statement: Each lower jaw platform bore four large oval holes oriented longitudinally, possibly representing vestigial tooth sockets.
facts.quote: Cada plataforma de la pata está perforada por cuatro agujeros ovalados bastante grandes, con el eje largo orientado en la dirección longitudinal, tal vez un remanente rudimentario de invernaderos dentales.

facts.statement: The surangular bone possessed a powerful coronoid process.
facts.quote: El surangular tiene una poderosa protuberancia coronoidea.

facts.statement: The last sacral vertebra had large pleurocoels on its sides and a long longitudinal groove on its underside.
facts.quote: La última vértebra sacra tiene grandes pleurocoelos en los lados y un largo surco longitudinal en la parte inferior.

facts.statement: The sacral ribs were robust and one and a half times longer than the vertebral body.
facts.quote: Las costillas sacras son robustas, una vez y media más largas que el cuerpo vertebral.

facts.statement: Anterior joint projections extended halfway along the sacral vertebra, likely limiting the mobility of the tail base.
facts.quote: Las proyecciones de la articulación anterior sobresalen hasta la mitad de la longitud de la vértebra sacra, que debe haber limitado la movilidad de la base de la cola.

facts.statement: Gobiraptor had a non-arctometatarsal foot, meaning the third metatarsal was not pinched at the top.
facts.quote: El pie medio no es arctometatarsal. El tercer metatarsiano, por lo tanto, no se pellizca en la parte superior.

facts.statement: The foot claws were slightly curved.
facts.quote: Las garras del pie son ligeramente curvas.

facts.statement: The scapula was not fused to the glenoid cavity, a characteristic indicating a juvenile age.
facts.quote: El omóplato no está fusionado con la cavidad glenoidea, un signo de una edad temprana.

facts.statement: The only known species, Gobiraptor minutus, is known from a single incomplete holotype specimen, MPC-D 102/111.
facts.quote: El tipo y la única especie es Gobiraptor minutus, conocido a partir de un solo espécimen incompleto, el holotipo MPC-D 102/111.

facts.statement: The specific name means 'the diminutive' in Latin, referring to the small size of the type specimen.
facts.quote: El nombre específico significa «el diminuto» en latín, una referencia al tamaño pequeño de la muestra tipo.

facts.statement: The holotype was found in the Nemegt Formation, dating to the early Maastrichtian, approximately 70 million years ago.
facts.quote: El holotipo, MPC-D 102/111, se encontró en una capa de la Formación Nemegt, que probablemente data del Maastrichtiano temprano, de unos 70 millones de años.

facts.statement: Research indicates Gobiraptor was not closely related to other oviraptorids sharing its environment.
facts.quote: Se ha encontrado que no está estrechamente relacionado con los otros ovirraptóridos con los que comparte su entorno.

facts.statement: Gobiraptor is classified within the family Oviraptoridae in the suborder Oviraptorosauria.
facts.quote: Gobiraptor se colocó dentro de Oviraptoridae en Oviraptorosauria.

facts.statement: Researchers suspect Gobiraptor might actually be a juvenile Caenagnathidae that was misclassified as an Oviraptorid due to its low maturity in the analysis, because its thickened lower jaw front is a trait found in Caenagnathidae, not Oviraptoridae.
facts.quote: El resultado es algo sospechoso porque el engrosamiento distintivo de las mandíbulas inferiores delanteras no se produce en Oviraptoridae, sino en el otro grupo principal oviraptorosauriano el Caenagnathidae.

facts.statement: Authors considered it unlikely that Gobiraptor was a carnivore because its foot was not arctometatarsian and it was not specialized for running.
facts.quote: Como su pie no era arctometatarsiano y el animal no era una forma especializada en la carrera, los autores que lo describieron consideraron poco probable que Gobiraptor fuera un carnívoro.

facts.statement: Gobiraptor had thick lower jaws specialized for crushing hard foods like bivalves, seeds, and other tough plant matter.
facts.quote: Las mandíbulas inferiores gruesas delanteras estaban especializadas para triturar alimentos como bivalvos, durófago y semillas, granívoro.

facts.statement: Gobiraptor lived during the Maastrichtian stage, from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Gobiraptor lived in a mesohabitat that was moderately dry.
facts.quote: Gobiraptor vivía en un mesohábitat, uno que estaba medio seco.
